supported: SELECT/FROM/INNER or LEFT JOIN/ON/WHERE, ordered nonrecursive CTEs, one nesting level of derived table or EXISTS subquery; explicit projection aliases may name output columns; no GROUP BY or aggregate syntax required
comments: -- line and /* block */; string literals use SQL single-quote escaping
scope_rules: derived table is not LATERAL and cannot see outer aliases; EXISTS may correlate; inner aliases shadow outer aliases; CTEs only expose resolvable output names
output: suggestions include label, kind, insertion text, origin and replacement [start,end) Unicode codepoint range; state unknown when scope cannot be recovered
